Dash is the first Korean BL novel I've ever read, and I was deeply impressed by it. Even though I relied on my browser's machine translation, which made it difficult to fully appreciate the writing style and all the layers of meaning, it didn't stop me from enjoying the story or falling in love with the chemistry and charm of the two main characters.
My favorite character in the novel is Jiheon. He's a strong person, yet he carries so many thoughts and worries within himself. When he falls in love with Jaekyoung, he becomes incredibly sweet and captivating, no wonder Jaekyoung could never forget him.
The beginning of the novel is admittedly quite slow-paced, but since I started reading it after the webtoon, that wasn't a problem for me. I highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys slow-burn romances, and omegaverse
